name: Witch Doctor: the client's cast time for the ranged-slot abilities includes the server's 500 ms ranged preparation (#6973)
contract: SpellInfo::CalcCastTime adds 500 ms to every ranged-slot spell that is not an auto repeat, so Reclamation and
Spirit Volley cast in 2300 ms before haste. The client's own SpellCastTimes table holds 1800 ms for their
CastingTimeIndex, and the client's tooltip and cast bar use that table, so the client showed 500 ms less than
the server cast. CoA's own client data compensates for this by storing base + 500 in the client's table (the
Moon Arrow ranks 803919-803925 carry 2500 ms where the server's data carries 2000 ms), which is only possible
for rows the server does not overwrite. The server therefore streams a Spell.dbc row for the affected
abilities whose CastingTimeIndex points at the 2300 ms row (31), so the client's tooltip and cast bar agree
with the server. The server's own cast time is unchanged.

steps.label: Let login and the client patch stream settle
The client receives 2300 ms for Reclamation rank 8
The client receives 2300 ms for Reclamation rank 5
The client receives 2300 ms for Spirit Volley
The server still casts Reclamation rank 8 in 2300 ms
The streamed row carries the Reclamation attributes at their known offset
Spirit Glaive is not a ranged-prepared spell, so the server streams no cast time for it
